status: PRE-REGISTERED: written and committed before any extraction was run on these fixtures. Requirements, gates and rules are not to be edited after results are seen; post-hoc analyses go into the report, labelled as such.

matrix.call: trafilatura.extract(fixture_bytes, url=<fixture url>, output_format=<format>, include_links=<L>, include_tables=<T>, include_formatting=<F>, **mode_kwargs); all other arguments at their defaults

gates.links: required iff include_links=True; otherwise recorded as EXCLUDED_BY_OPTION
gates.tables: required iff include_tables=True; otherwise recorded as EXCLUDED_BY_OPTION
gates.formatting: required iff include_formatting=True or output_format='markdown' (documented: 'Selecting Markdown automatically includes text formatting'); otherwise EXCLUDED_BY_OPTION
gates.structure: required for output_format in {markdown, xml}; recorded as INFO for txt

rules.R1_views: txt/markdown: raw = output string; plain = raw with CommonMark backslash escapes removed (backslash followed by ASCII punctuation -> the punctuation). xml: parse the output; plain = ' '.join(root.itertext()); flat = ''.join(root.itertext()).
rules.R2_statement: tokens(s) = re.findall(r'\w+', s). PASS iff tokens(statement) is a contiguous subsequence of tokens(plain).
rules.R3_code_chars: txt/markdown: PASS iff the code string is a substring of raw (no unescaping: an escape inserted into code is a loss). xml: PASS iff substring of flat.
rules.R4_code_marked: txt/markdown: PASS iff raw contains '`' + code + '`'. xml: PASS iff some element with tag 'code', or tag 'hi' with rend '#t', has ''.join(itertext()) == code.
rules.R5_code_block: block is compared with LF newlines and without its final newline. txt/markdown: PASS iff block is a substring of raw. xml: PASS iff block is a substring of flat. Whether the block is marked as code (markdown fence / xml <code>) is recorded as INFO.
rules.R6_list_nesting: markdown/txt: PASS iff there is a line L1 matching ^(\s*)[-*+]\s whose tokens contain tokens(parent) contiguously, and a later line L2 matching ^(\s*)[-*+]\s whose tokens contain tokens(item) contiguously, with indent(L2) > indent(L1). xml: PASS iff some <item> I contains tokens(item) contiguously in ' '.join(I.itertext()) and has an ancestor <item> A (A is not I) containing tokens(parent) contiguously.
rules.R7_emphasis_marked: txt/markdown: PASS iff raw contains m + word + m for one of the listed markdown markers m. xml: PASS iff some <hi> with rend in the listed rend values has ''.join(itertext()) == word.
rules.R8_table_row: txt/markdown: PASS iff some line, after strip() and removal of one leading and one trailing '|', split on '|' not preceded by a backslash, gives cells that equal the expected list after each cell is stripped, unescaped (R1) and loses one pair of enclosing backticks. xml: PASS iff some <row> has <cell> children whose whitespace-collapsed ' '.join(itertext()).strip() equal the expected list.
rules.R9_link: txt/markdown: PASS iff raw contains '[' + anchor + '](' + target + ')' or '[' + anchor + '](<' + target + '>)'. xml: PASS iff some <ref> has target == expected target and ''.join(itertext()).strip() == anchor.
rules.R10_boilerplate: INFO: the listed boilerplate strings found in plain (case-sensitive). Not a pass/fail criterion.
rules.R11_loss: A loss is a FAIL of a requirement whose gate is on. Every loss is reported with its configuration. Output length is recorded but never used as evidence of correctness.
rules.R12_no_output: If extract() returns None, every gated-on requirement is a FAIL.
